The '''Observatory''' is a complex mostly used during the [[Observatory Quest]]. It consists of four parts. The area was overrun by [[goblin]]s, who have damaged the telescope, and players must fix it during the [[quest]]. The original bridge to the Observatory has been destroyed, so you must go underground at the ruined buildings and through the [[Observatory Dungeon]] to get to it. Alternatively, players who have completed the Observatory Quest can use the [[grapple shortcut]] with 23 [[Agility]], 24 [[Ranged]], and 28 [[Strength]]. It should be noted that players who use this shortcut forfeit their [[mith grapple]], but in doing so create a permanent shortcut.

==Transportation==
* [[Ring of dueling]] teleport to [[Castle Wars]] and go north
* [[Ourania Teleport]] and go south

To get to the Observatory itself, the player has to either go through the [[Observatory Dungeon]], or use the [[Rocks (Observatory)|shortcut]].

== Inhabitants ==
* [[Observatory professor]]; after [[Observatory Quest]]

== Features ==

=== {{FloorNumber|uk=0|caps=y}} ===

* There are [[star chart]]s on the walls around the room.
* The front door can be used to quickly leave, if the player has unlocked the grapple shortcut.
* [[STASH#Medium|STASH (Medium)]], where the player can store a [[mithril chainbody]], [[Green d'hide chaps|green d'hide chaps,]]  and a [[ruby amulet]].

=== {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} ===

* [[Telescope (Observatory)]]

== Agility shortcut ==
{{Main|Rocks (Observatory)}}
After completing the [[Observatory Quest]], players with 23 [[Agility]], 24 [[Ranged]], and 28 [[Strength]] can create a permanent [[grapple shortcut]] for quick access. Creating the shortcut requires a [[Crossbow (weapon)|crossbow]] and a [[mithril grapple]]. The mithril grapple will be consumed, but the shortcut remains permanent after that. 

To get back down, players have to use the Observatory's front door.

==Trivia==
*In {{UD|Upcoming Changes and Fake XP Drop Improvements|an update}} on [[22 March]] [[2018]], the examine text of the telescope was changed to a quote by {{wp|Stephen Hawking}} to honour his memory - "''Remember to look up at the stars and not down at your feet''". Previously, the examine text was "''Looking through it makes far off things seem closer.''"
*[[Coordinates]] 0°00' degrees north and 0°00' degrees east is located in the middle of the Observatory.
